text_block_list.text:
Having conquered the Japan Cup, Neo 
Universe realized that the "connections" 
could be expanded even further.

Not just with friends. Even with the 
"Great King" or the "Singularity"... Even 
with the opponents she was set to face, 
she could still exchange "Love."

And there was one more thing Neo Universe 
wanted to tell her Trainer after
finishing 
the race.

Neo Universe has finally returned.
Bearing the victory she could not offer in
another 
universe, back to the timeline that was 
always meant to continue.
